zh: 当邵友濂谒见李鸿章，谈妥了以打击胡雪岩作为对左宗棠掣肘的主要手段时，胡雪岩不过刚刚到了江宁。原来胡雪岩与螺蛳太太商量行程，螺蛳太太力主先到江宁，后到上海。胡雪岩觉得她的打算很妥当，因为由于螺蛳太太的夸奖，他才知道宓本常应变的本事很到家，这样就方便了，在南京动静要伺候左宗棠，身不由主，到了上海，是宓本常伺候自己，即令有未了之事，可以交给宓本常去料理，欲去欲留，随心所欲，决不会耽误了为女儿主持嘉礼这一件大事。于是，他一面写信通知宓本常与古应春，一面打点到江宁的行李——行李中大部分是送人的土仪。江宁候补道最多，有句戏言叫做“群‘道，如毛”。这些候补道终年派不到一个差使，但三品大员的排场，不能不摆，所以一个个苦不堪言，只盼当肥缺阔差使的朋友到江宁公干，才有稍资沾润的机会。胡雪岩在江宁的熟人很多，又是“财神”，这趟去自然东西是东西、银子是银子，个个要应酬到。银子还可在江宁阜康支用，土仪却必须从杭州带去，整整装满一船，连同胡雪岩专用的座船，由长江水师特为派来的小人轮拖带，经嘉兴、苏州直驶江宁。当此时也，李鸿章亦以密电致上海道邵友濂，要他赴津一行，有要事面谈。上海道是地方官，不能擅离职守，所以在密电中说明，总理衙门另有电报。关照他先作准备，等总理衙门的公事一到，立即航海北上。公事是胡雪岩从杭州动身以后，才到上海的。但因上海到天津的海道，费时只得两天一夜，所以邵友濂见到李鸿章时，胡雪岩还在路上。
en: By the time Shao Youlian had met Li Hongzhang and agreed that striking at Hu Xueyan would be their principal means of obstructing Zuo Zongtang, Hu had only just reached Jiangning. When he discussed his itinerary with Madam Luosi, she strongly urged him to visit Jiangning before Shanghai. He thought her reasoning sound. Her praise of Mi Benchang had made him realize how well Mi could handle unexpected situations, which simplified matters. In Nanjing he must attend upon Zuo and could not control his own movements. In Shanghai, Mi would attend upon him. Any unfinished business could be left to Mi, allowing him to come and go as he pleased without missing the important duty of presiding over his daughter's wedding. He wrote to Mi and Gu Yingchun while preparing his baggage, most of which consisted of local gifts. Jiangning had more expectant circuit intendants than anywhere else, giving rise to a joke that its “circuit men were as thick as hairs.” They might go a whole year without an assignment, yet still had to maintain the appearance of third-rank dignitaries. Struggling to do so, they awaited visits from friends holding lucrative posts, hoping for a little help. Hu had many acquaintances there and was the God of Wealth. Everyone must receive attention, in gifts or silver. The silver could be drawn from Fukang in Jiangning, but the Hangzhou gifts filled an entire boat. A small steamer specially sent by the Yangtze naval forces towed it and Hu's private passenger boat through Jiaxing and Suzhou to Jiangning. Meanwhile, Li secretly telegraphed Shao, the Shanghai circuit intendant, summoning him to Tianjin for an important personal discussion. As a local official, Shao could not leave his post without authorization, so Li explained that a separate telegram would come from the Zongli Yamen. Shao was to prepare and sail north as soon as its official instructions arrived. They reached Shanghai only after Hu had left Hangzhou. But the sea passage to Tianjin took just two days and a night; when Shao saw Li, Hu was still on his way.

zh: 这南北洋两大臣各召亲信，目的恰好相反。左宗棠主战，积极筹划南洋防务以外，全力支持督办广东军务的钦差大臣彭玉麟。李鸿章则表面虽不敢违犯清议，但暗中却用尽了釜底抽薪的手段，削弱主战派的力量及声势。第一个目标是左副都御史张佩纶，因为他是主战派领袖大学士李鸿藻的谋主，制服他亦就是擒贼擒王之意。就压制主战派这个目的来说，收服张佩纶是治本，打击胡雪岩是治标。
en: The ministers responsible for the northern and southern maritime administrations were thus each summoning a trusted man, but for opposite purposes. Zuo favoured war. Besides actively preparing southern coastal defences, he fully supported Peng Yulin, the imperial commissioner supervising military affairs in Guangdong. Li, though unwilling openly to defy respectable public opinion, secretly used every means to remove the war party's support and weaken its power and prestige. His first target was Zhang Peilun, the Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief, chief strategist for Grand Secretary Li Hongzao, leader of the war party. Bringing Zhang under control would be like capturing the leader to subdue the band. In terms of suppressing the advocates of war, winning Zhang over dealt with the root; attacking Hu dealt with the branches.

zh: 可是首当其冲的胡雪岩，却还睡在鼓里，到了江宁，先到他自己所置的公馆休息。胡雪岩在通都大邑，都置有公馆，但一年难得一到，江宁因为左宗棠的关系，这年是第二次来往。这个公馆的“女主人”姓王，原是秦淮“旧院”钓鱼巷的者鸨，运气不佳，两个养女，连着出事，一个殉情，一个私奔，私奔的可以不追究，殉情的却连累老鸨吃了人命官司，好不容易才得无罪被释，心灰意懒再不愿意吃这碗“把势饭”了。既然如此，只有从良之一途。这个王鸨，就象《板桥杂记》中所写的李香君的假母那样，虽鸨不老，三十出头年纪，丰韵犹存，要从良亦着实有人愿量珠来聘。但秦淮的勾栏中人，承袭了明末清初“旧院”的遗风，讲究饮食起居，看得骚人墨客，而看中她的，腰有万金之缠，身无一骨之雅；她看中的，温文尔雅，不免寒酸。因而空有从良之志，难得终身之托。
en: Hu, who would bear the first blow, knew nothing of this. On reaching Jiangning, he went first to rest at his own residence. He kept houses in the great cities but rarely visited them even once a year. Because of Zuo, this was his second stay at Jiangning that year. The “mistress” of this house was surnamed Wang. She had formerly run a brothel in Diaoyu Lane in Qinhuai's Old Quarter, but misfortune had struck her two adopted daughters in succession: one died for love, and the other eloped. The elopement could be left alone, but the death involved Madam Wang in a homicide case. She was finally acquitted and released, yet so disheartened that she no longer wished to earn her living by that precarious trade. The only alternative was to leave it and marry. Like Li Xiangjun's adoptive mother in Miscellaneous Records of Banqiao, she was a madam without being old, only a little over thirty and still attractive. There were men willing to offer riches for her. But Qinhuai courtesans inherited the Old Quarter's traditions from the late Ming and early Qing. They cared about refinement in food and daily life and admired poets and cultivated men. Those who wanted her had fortunes but no trace of elegance; those she wanted were gentle and refined but poor. She wished to leave the profession, yet could find no one to entrust her future to.

zh: 这是三年前的事，江宁阜康新换一个档手，名叫江德源，此人是由阜康调过来的，深通风月，得知有王鸨这么一个人，延聘她来当“胡公馆”的管家，平时作为应酬特等客户的处所，等“东家”到江宁，她便是“主持中馈”的“主妇”。当然，这“主妇”的责任，也包括房帏之事在内。王鸨为胡公馆的饮食起居舒服，且又不受拘束，欣然同意。那年秋天，胡雪岩到江宁，首先就看中了她的裙下双钩，纤如新月，一夕缱绻，真如袁子才所说的“徐娘风味胜雏年”，厚赠以外，送了她一个外号叫做“王九妈”，南宋发生在西湖上的，有名的“卖油郎独占花魁女”的故事，其中的老鸨就叫王九妈。这王九妈已得到江德源的通知，早就迎合胡雪岩的喜好，除饮食方面有预备以外，另外还打听了许多新闻，作为陪伴闲谈的资料。
en: That was three years earlier. Jiangning Fukang had just acquired a new manager, Jiang Deyuan, transferred from another Fukang establishment. Well versed in the world of pleasure, he heard of her and hired her to manage Hu's residence. Normally it entertained especially important clients; when the proprietor visited, she became its hostess, presiding over the household. Those duties naturally extended to the bedroom. Comfortable living and freedom from restraint made her readily accept. When Hu came that autumn, the first thing to attract him was the pair of tiny curved feet beneath her skirt, slender as crescent moons. After a night together, he found Yuan Zicai's saying true: “A mature woman's charms surpass those of youth.” Besides generous gifts, he gave her the name Mother Wang Jiu, after the brothel keeper in the famous Southern Song tale set on West Lake, The Oil Vendor Wins the Flower Queen. Now, warned by Jiang, she had prepared Hu's favourite food and gathered plenty of news to entertain him.

zh: 这些新闻中，胡雪岩最关切的，自然是有关左宗棠的情形。据说他衰病侵寻，意气更甚，接见僚属宾客，不能谈西征，一谈便开了他的“话匣子”，铺陈西征的勋业，御将如何恩威并用，用兵如何神奇莫测。再接下来便要骂人，第一个被骂的是曾国藩，其次是李鸿章，有时兼骂沈葆祯。这三个人都是左宗棠的前任，有好些旧部在江宁，尤其是曾国藩故旧更多，而且就人品来说，左宗棠骂李鸿章犹可，骂曾国藩则不免令人不服，因此，曾国藩的旧部，每每大庭广众之间批评他说：“大帅对老帅有意见，他们之间的恩怨，亦难说得很。就算老帅不对，人都过去了，也听不见他的骂，何必在我们面前罗嗦。而且道理不直，话亦不圆，说来说去，无非老帅把持饷源，处处回护九帅，耳朵里都听得生茧了。”胡雪岩心想，也不过半年未见左宗棠，何以老境颓唐至此？便有些不大相信，及至一问江德源，果然如此，他说：“江宁现在许多事办不通。为什么呢？左大人先开讲，后开骂，一个人滔滔不绝，说到时候差不多了，戈什哈把茶碗交到他手里，外面伺候的人马上喊一声‘送客’。根本就没法子谈公事。”
en: Naturally, Hu cared most about news of Zuo. He was said to be increasingly old and infirm, but more overbearing than ever. Visitors and subordinates must never mention the western campaign: it opened a floodgate of talk about his achievements, his combination of kindness and authority in handling generals, and the miraculous unpredictability of his strategy. Then came the abuse, first of Zeng Guofan, next of Li Hongzhang, and sometimes of Shen Baozhen too. All three had preceded him in office, and many of their former subordinates remained in Jiangning, especially Zeng's. Whatever might be said of Li, people resented attacks on Zeng's character. Zeng's old followers often complained openly: “The present commander has grievances against the old commander. The rights and wrongs between them are hard to judge. Even if the old commander was at fault, he is dead and cannot hear the abuse. Why must we endure it? Besides, the arguments are neither just nor convincing. It all comes down to the same thing: he monopolized military funds and protected Ninth Marshal. We have heard it until our ears have grown calluses.” Hu wondered how Zuo could have declined so much in the mere six months since they last met. He was doubtful until Jiang confirmed it. “Many things cannot be done in Jiangning now. His Excellency begins with a lecture, then starts abusing people, talking without pause. When the allotted time is nearly over, a guard puts a teacup into his hand and someone outside immediately calls, ‘See the guest out!’ There is no chance to discuss business.”

zh: “这是难得一次吧？”“哪里？可说天天如此。”江德源说，“左大人有点‘人来疯’，人越多他越起劲。大先生亦不必讲究礼节。‘上院，去见，不如就此刻在花厅或者签押房里见，倒可以谈点正经。”原来督抚接见“两司”——藩司、桌司以及道员以下的僚属，大致五天一次，“衙参”之期定在逢三、逢八的日子居多，接见之处，称为“官厅”，而衙参称之为“上院”。胡雪岩到的这天是十月十七，原想第二天“上院”，如今听江德源这一说，决定接受他的建议，当即换了官服，坐轿直闯两江总督的辕门。
en: “Surely that happens only occasionally?” “Almost every day. He becomes more excited with a larger audience. You needn't stand on ceremony, sir. Instead of attending a formal audience, go now and see him in the garden reception room or his office. Then you might discuss something useful.” Governors-general and governors generally received the provincial treasurer and judicial commissioner, together with circuit intendants and lesser subordinates, about once every five days, often on dates ending in three or eight. These formal visits, called “going up to the court,” took place in the official reception hall. Hu had arrived on the seventeenth of the tenth lunar month and intended to attend on the eighteenth. Accepting Jiang's advice, he instead put on his official robes at once and went straight by sedan chair to the Liangjiang governor-general's gates.

zh: 辕门上一看“胡财神”到了，格外巴结，擅作主张开正门，让轿子抬到官厅檐前下轿，随即通报到上房，传出话来：“请胡大人换了便服，在签押房见面。”于是跟班打开衣包，就在官厅上换了便服，引人签押房，左宗棠已经在等了，胡雪岩自然是行大礼请安，左宗棠亲手相扶，延入客座，少不得有一番寒暄。胡雪岩一面说话，一面细看左宗棠的眼睛，左眼已长了一层白翳，右眼见风流泪，非常厉害，不时拿一块绸绢擦拭，于是找一个空隙说道：“听说大人的眼睛不好，我特为配了一副眼药来，清凉明目，很有效验，”说着，将随手携带的一个小锦袱解开来又说：“还替大人配了一服膏滋药，如果服得好，请大人交代书启师爷写信来，我再送来。”“多谢，多谢！”左宗棠说：“我现在多靠几个朋友帮忙，不但私务，连公事都要累你。上次山东闹水灾，两江派助赈四十万，藩库只拿得出一半，多亏你慷慨援手。不过，这笔款子，两江还无法奉还。”“大人不必挂齿。”胡雪岩原想再说一句：“有官款在我那里，我是应该效劳的。”但话到口边，又缩了回去。
en: Seeing the God of Wealth, the gatekeepers were exceptionally attentive. On their own authority they opened the main gate and let his sedan be carried to the eaves of the reception hall. Word was sent inside, and instructions came back: “Ask His Excellency Hu to change into informal clothes. We shall meet in the office.” His attendant opened the clothes bundle, and Hu changed in the hall before being shown into the office, where Zuo was already waiting. Hu naturally made his full ceremonial greeting. Zuo helped him up himself and led him to the guest seats, where they exchanged the usual courtesies. As they spoke, Hu studied his eyes. A white film covered the left, while the right watered badly in a draught, forcing him to wipe it repeatedly with a silk handkerchief. Finding an opening, Hu said, “I heard your eyes were troubling you and had a special medicine prepared. It is cooling and clears the sight, with very good results.” Undoing a small brocade bundle he had brought, he added, “I also had a medicinal paste made for you. If it agrees with you, have your correspondence secretary write, and I shall send more.” “Thank you! Nowadays I depend on a few friends for help, not just with private matters; even official business must trouble you. When Shandong suffered floods, Liangjiang was assigned four hundred thousand taels for relief, and the provincial treasury could provide only half. Your generous help saved us. But Liangjiang still cannot repay you.” “Please don't mention it.” Hu nearly added that, with public funds deposited with him, he ought to be of service, but checked the words before speaking.

zh: “这一回越南吃紧，朝命彭雪琴督办广东军务，我跟他三十年的交情，不能不助他一臂之力，而况我奉旨筹办南洋防务，粤闽洋面，亦在我管辖之下，其势更不能兼筹并顾。可恨的是，两江官场，从曾湘乡以来，越搞越坏，推拖敷衍，不顾大局，以致于我又要靠老朋友帮忙了。”“是。”胡雪岩很沉重地答应着。“王阆青已经出京回湖南去招兵了，打算招六千人，总要有四千支枪才够用。江宁的军械局，为李少荃的大舅子搞得一塌糊涂，交上海制造局赶办，第一是经费尚无着落，其次是时间上缓不济急，所以我想由转运局来想法了。雪岩，你说呢？““转运局库存洋枪，细数我还不知道。不过大人既然交代要四千支，我无论如何要想法子办齐。”“好！”左宗棠说：“我就知道，跟你商量不过是一句话的事，最痛快不过。”“光塘……”胡雪岩称名谦谢：“承大人栽培，不敢不尽心尽力伺候。”
en: “With the situation in Vietnam urgent, the court has ordered Peng Xueqin to supervise military affairs in Guangdong. We have been friends for thirty years, and I must help him. Moreover, I have been commanded to prepare southern maritime defences. The waters off Guangdong and Fujian fall within my jurisdiction; I cannot neglect them. What infuriates me is that, since Zeng of Xiangxiang's time, officialdom in Liangjiang has grown steadily worse. Evasion and delay, with no thought for the wider situation—so once again I must rely on old friends.” Hu assented gravely. “Wang Langqing has left Beijing for Hunan to recruit six thousand men. He will need at least four thousand rifles. Li Shaoquan's elder brother-in-law has made a complete mess of the Jiangning Arsenal. If we order the Shanghai Manufacturing Bureau to produce them, first the money is not yet available, and second they cannot arrive in time for the emergency. So I thought the Transport Bureau might find a way. What do you say, Xueyan?” “I don't yet know the exact number of Western rifles in stock. But if you require four thousand, I shall find some means of supplying the full number.” “Good! I knew that a word to you would settle it. Nothing could be more satisfying.” Referring to himself respectfully by his personal name, Hu replied, “Guangyong owes everything to your patronage. I dare not fail to serve you with all my heart and strength.”

zh: “好说，好说。还有件事，王阆青招来的兵，粮饷自然由户部去筹划，一笔开拔费，数目可观，两江不能不量力相助。雪岩，你能不能再帮两江一个忙？”如果是过去，胡雪岩一定会问：“要多少？”但目前情形不同，他想了一下说：“回大人的话，现在市面上银根紧得不得了，就是不紧，大人要顾到老部下。如今我遵大人的吩咐，要多少筹多少，到了陕甘接济不上时，就变成从井救人了。”所谓“老部下”是指刘锦棠，而胡雪岩又是西征转运局的委员，在他的职司有主有从，如两江筹饷是额外的差使，行有余力，不妨效劳，否则他当然要顾全西征军为主。左宗棠了解到这一点，便不能不有所顾虑，想了一下说道：“这样吧，明天我再找藩司来想法子。如果真有难处，那就不能不仰赖老兄拔刀相助了。”“大人言重。”胡雪岩问道：“不知道什么时候再来请示。”“请示”便是听回音。左宗棠答说：“很快、很快，三两天之内，就有信息。”于是胡雪岩起身说道：“我听大人的指挥办理，今天就告辞了。”“嗯，嗯。”左宗棠问：“今天晚上没事吧？”胡雪岩知道要留他吃饭，急说道：“今天晚上有个不能不去的饭局。”“既然如此，我不留你了。我知道你事情多，不必来看我，等有了信息，我自然会派人来请你。”
en: “You are too modest. There is something else. The Ministry of Revenue will of course arrange pay and provisions for Wang's recruits, but the cost of mobilizing them is considerable. Liangjiang must contribute what it can. Could you help us once more?” In the past, Hu would simply have asked how much. Circumstances were different now. After a little thought, he replied, “Your Excellency, money is desperately tight in the market. Even if it were not, you must consider your old subordinate. If I raise whatever you ask now and later cannot supply Shaanxi and Gansu, I shall be like a man who jumps into a well to rescue someone.” The old subordinate was Liu Jintang. Hu held a commission with the western expedition's Transport Bureau, and his responsibilities had an order of priority. Raising funds for Liangjiang was additional work, which he could undertake if he had capacity to spare. Otherwise, the western army must come first. Zuo understood and could not disregard the concern. “Very well. Tomorrow I shall speak to the provincial treasurer again. If there really is difficulty, we shall have to rely on you to come to our rescue.” “You are too kind. When should I return for instructions?” By instructions, Hu meant the answer. “Soon. There will be news within two or three days.” Hu rose. “I shall act as you direct. For today, I take my leave.” “Are you free this evening?” Realizing that Zuo meant to invite him to dinner, Hu quickly said that he had an engagement he could not miss. “Then I won't keep you. I know you are busy. There is no need to call again. When there is news, I shall send for you.”

zh: 于是胡雪岩请安辞出。接着便转往秦淮河河房去赴宴会，在座的都是江宁官场上提得起来的人物，消息特别灵通，胡雪岩倒是听了许多内幕，据说李鸿章已向总理衙门正式表明他的看法，中国实力不足，对越南之事应早结束，舍此别无良法。但总理衙门主张将法国对中国种种挟制及无理的要求，照会世界各国，以明其曲在彼。如果法军来犯，即与开战。李鸿章虽不以为然，无奈他想谈和，连对手都没有，法国的特使德理固已转往日本去了。“中国的若恼是，欲和不敢和，欲战不能战。”督署的洋务委员候补道张凤池说：“现在是彼此‘耗’的局面，就不知道谁耗得过谁了？”“那么，照凤翁看，是哪个耗得过哪个？”“这一层很难说。不过，在法国，原来只有他们的外务部长最强硬，现在意见已经融洽了，他们的内阁总理在国会演说：决心在越南打到底。而我们呢，朝廷两大柱石，纵不说势如水火，可是南辕北辙，说不到一起，大为可虑。”所谓“朝廷两大住石”，自是指李鸿章与左宗棠。在座的虽以两江的官员居多，但其中跟李鸿章渊源甚深的也不少，谈到李、左不和，是个犯忌讳的话题，如果出言不慎，会惹麻烦上身，所以都保持着沉默。
en: After his farewell salute, Hu went to a banquet in a riverside house on the Qinhuai. The guests were prominent men in Jiangning officialdom, unusually well informed, and he learned much inside news. Li Hongzhang was said to have formally told the Zongli Yamen that China's strength was insufficient and the Vietnamese affair must be settled promptly: there was no other satisfactory course. The Yamen, however, favoured notifying the countries of the world of France's coercion and unreasonable demands, making clear that the fault lay with France. If French troops attacked, China should fight. Li disagreed, but even if he wanted negotiations, he had no one to negotiate with: the French special envoy Tricou had left for Japan. “China's difficulty is that we want peace but dare not make it, and want war but cannot fight it,” said Zhang Fengchi, an expectant circuit intendant serving as foreign-affairs commissioner at the governor-general's headquarters. “Now each side is trying to outlast the other. The question is which can do it.” “Who do you think will last longer, Mr Feng?” “Hard to say. In France, only the foreign minister was initially so intransigent, but opinion has now become united. Their premier told parliament that they were determined to fight to the end in Vietnam. Meanwhile, our court's two great pillars may not be fire and water, but they are certainly pulling in opposite directions and cannot agree. That is deeply worrying.” The two pillars were plainly Li and Zuo. Most guests were Liangjiang officials, but many had close ties to Li. Their quarrel was a dangerous topic: an incautious word could bring trouble. Everyone remained silent.

zh: 只有一个人是例外，此人是山东的一个候补道，名叫玉桂，蒙古旗人，原来在两江候补，署道实缺，也当过好些差使，资格甚老，年纪最长，大家都叫他“王大哥”。此人理路很明白，勇于任事，本来是应该红起来的一个能员，只以心直口快，妨了他的官运。这回是奉山东巡抚所派，到江宁来谒见左宗棠，商议疏浚运河，哪知来了半个月，始终不得要领，以致牢骚满腹，一提到李左不和，忍不住要开口了。“左、李两公，勋业彪炳，天下仰望，朝廷酬庸有功，封侯拜相，过去的战功是过去了，可以不谈了，好汉不提当年勇，何必呢？”这明明是在说左宗棠。八座咫尺，忌讳益甚，更没有人敢置一词。有了三分酒意的玉桂，只当大家默许他的议论，因而就更起劲了，“如说打仗，兵贵神速，倘或一天到晚说空话，正事不只，到得兵临城下，还在大谈春风已度玉门关，各位倒想，那会弄成怎么一个局面？”听得这番话，座客相顾失色。有跟玉桂交情比较深的，便很替他担心，因为这话一传到左宗棠耳朵里，就一定会找上他去，如果只是痛斥一顿倒还罢了，就怕找了他去质问：你说“兵临城下”是什么兵？是法国军队吗？一怒之下，指名严劾，安上他一个危言惑众、动摇民心士气的罪名，起码也是一个革职的处分。于是有人便乱以他语：“玉大哥、玉大哥，今宵只可谈风月，喝酒，喝酒。”
en: Everyone, that is, except one man. Yugui, an expectant circuit intendant in Shandong, was a Mongol Bannerman. He had formerly awaited appointment in Liangjiang, acted in an established circuit post and held many assignments. Senior in service and the oldest man present, he was called Brother Yu by everyone. Clear-minded and ready to shoulder responsibility, he should have risen as an able official, but his blunt speech had harmed his prospects. The Shandong governor had sent him to consult Zuo about dredging the Grand Canal. He had spent half a month in Jiangning without getting anywhere, leaving him full of grievances. At mention of the quarrel, he could not remain silent. “Lords Zuo and Li have illustrious achievements and the admiration of the empire. The court has rewarded them with titles and high office. Their past military services are past; there is no need to keep discussing them. A true hero doesn't boast of former valour. Why do it?” He plainly meant Zuo. With the great official so near at hand, the subject became more perilous still, and nobody dared say a word. Slightly tipsy, Yugui took their silence as approval and grew more animated. “In war, speed is everything. If we talk emptily all day and neglect real work, what happens when the enemy reaches the city walls while we are still boasting that the spring wind has already passed the Jade Gate? Think what a state we shall be in!” The guests exchanged frightened looks. His closer friends were particularly worried. If this reached Zuo, Yugui would certainly be summoned. A severe scolding would be the least of it. What if Zuo asked, “What troops do you mean at the city walls? The French?” In anger, he could impeach Yugui by name for alarming the public and undermining civilian and military morale. Dismissal would be the minimum punishment. Someone hurriedly changed the subject. “Brother Yu, tonight let us discuss only pleasant things. Drink, drink!”

zh: 王桂还想再说，作主人的张凤池见机，大声说道：“玉大哥的黑头、黄钟仲吕，可以醒酒，来，来，来一段让我们饱饱耳福。”“对！”有人附和：“听玉大哥唱黑头，真是痛快淋漓。快，快，‘场面’呢？”文场、武场都现成，很快地摆设好了，“乌师”请示唱什么，张凤池便说，“玉大哥最拿手的是《探阴山》跟《上天台》。我看先上天台，后探阴山吧！”“不！”玉桂答说：“今天我反串，唱‘胡子’，来段《斩谡》。”等打鼓佬下鼓糙领起胡琴，过门一到，玉桂变了主意，“我还是唱《上天台》吧。”他说。原来玉桂编了一段辙儿，想骂左宗棠如失街亭的那个蜀中大将，“言过其言，终无大用”，但想想身居客地，而左宗棠到底是年高位尊，过于嚣张，实在也不很相宜，所以不为已甚。这些情形看在胡雪岩眼中颇有感触，回想当年左宗棠意气风发，连曾国藩都不能不让他几分，哪知如今老境颓唐，为人如此轻视，这样转着念头，一面为左宗棠悲哀，一面也不免兴起急流勇退的念头。
en: Yugui wanted to continue, but their host, Zhang Fengchi, seized his opportunity. “Brother Yu's black-faced roles ring like great bells and will sober us up. Come, give us a passage to delight our ears.” Others agreed enthusiastically. “His singing is wonderfully stirring. Quickly, where are the musicians?” String and wind players and percussionists were all available and soon took their places. When they asked what to play, Zhang said, “His specialities are Exploring Mount Yin and Ascending the Heavenly Terrace. Let us ascend the terrace first, then explore the mountain.” “No,” Yugui replied. “I shall change roles today and sing a bearded character. Give me Executing Ma Su.” The drummer struck up and the fiddle began. As the introductory music ended, Yugui changed his mind. “Better make it Ascending the Heavenly Terrace after all.” He had improvised some words to attack Zuo through the example of the Shu general who lost Jieting: “His words outrun his deeds; he will never be of great use.” But he reconsidered. He was a visitor here, and Zuo was, after all, an elderly man of high standing. Excessive insolence would be improper; he had better not go too far. Watching all this, Hu was deeply affected. He remembered Zuo in his vigorous prime, when even Zeng Guofan had to yield to him. Who could have imagined such decline in old age, and such contempt from others? Grieving for Zuo, he also began thinking of withdrawing while the current still ran strong.

zh: 在江宁已经十天了，左宗棠始终没有派人来请他去见面。由于他事先有话，胡雪岩不便再去求见，只有托熟人去打听。但始终不得要领。好不容易左宗棠来请了，一见面倒没有废话，开门见山地说：“雪岩，陕甘那面我另有部署，你把转运局的官款，拨二十五万出来。”这笔款子自然是拨给王德榜的，不加商量，直接交代，胡雪岩除了唯唯称是以外，别无话说。“这笔钱能不能在这里拨？”左宗棠问。“大人要在哪里拨就哪里拨！”“好，就在这里拨好了。你替王阆青立个折子。”“是。”“你什么时候回去？”“我一直在候大人的命，既然有了交代，我想明天就走。”“对了，你要回去办喜事？”左宗棠问：“令爱出阁，我已经告诉他们备贺札了。你我是患难之交，我不能去喝喜酒，中心未免歉然。”“大人言重了。”“我想再送点什么别致的贺礼。雪岩，你倒替我想想，不必客气。”“是。”胡雪岩想了一下说，“如果有大人亲笔的一副喜联，那就真的是蓬荜生辉了。”“这是小事。”左宗棠答说：“不过今天可来不及了，反正喜期以前，一定会送到。”“大人公务太忙，我这个实在算是非分之求。既蒙大人许了，我把喜堂最上面的位置留下来了。”
en: He had been in Jiangning ten days, yet Zuo had not sent for him. Given the earlier instruction, he could hardly seek another audience. He asked acquaintances to inquire, but learned nothing definite. At last the summons came. This time Zuo wasted no words. “Xueyan, I have made other arrangements for Shaanxi and Gansu. Allocate two hundred and fifty thousand from the Transport Bureau's public funds.” The money was plainly for Wang Debang. It was an order, with no discussion, and Hu could only assent. “Can it be paid here?” “Wherever you wish.” “Good. Here, then. Open an account for Wang Langqing and issue him a passbook.” “Yes.” “When will you leave?” “I have been awaiting your instructions. Now that they are settled, I hope to leave tomorrow.” “Yes, you must return for the wedding. I have already told them to prepare a congratulatory letter for your daughter's marriage. We have shared hardships; I feel sorry that I cannot attend the feast.” “You are too kind.” “I should like to send something distinctive as well. What would you suggest? Don't stand on ceremony.” Hu thought for a moment. “A pair of wedding couplets in your own hand would truly bring glory to our humble house.” “A small matter. There is no time today, but I shall certainly send them before the wedding.” “You are so busy with public affairs that I am asking more than I should. Since you have granted the request, I shall reserve the place of honour in the wedding hall.”

zh: 这是变相的坚约，左宗棠不可言而无信，否则喜堂正面，空着两块不好看。左宗棠理会得这层意思，便喊一声：“来啊！”“喳！”厅上一呼，廊下百诺，进来一名亮蓝顶子的材官，站在他身旁待命。“胡大人的小姐出阁，我许了送一副喜联，你只要看我稍为闲一点儿，就提醒我这件事，免得失礼。”左宗棠又说：“你要不断提醒我。”“是。”“好！就这么说了。”左宗棠又问，“你是先到上海？”“是的。”“有什么事要我替你招呼？”胡雪岩心里不放心的是，那笔到期还本的洋债，为限已近，但看宓本常并无信来，谅想已经办妥，就不必再请左宗棠费事了。“等有事再来求大人。”“好！”左宗棠说：“这回你来，我连请你吃顿饭的工夫都抽不出来，实在有点说不过去。““大人太客气了。”胡雪岩问：“不知道大人在上海、在杭州，有什么委办的事没有？”左宗棠想了一下说：“就是王阆青的那四千支枪。“这件事，我一定办妥当。”“别的就没有了。”左宗棠说：“就要你那句话，想起来再托你。”胡雪岩告辞而去，又重重地托了那些材官，务必提醒喜联那件事。当然，少不得还有一个上写“别敬”的红包奉送。
en: This was an indirect way of making the promise binding. Zuo could not fail to keep his word, leaving two blank spaces in the place of honour. Understanding, he called for an attendant. An answer rang from the corridor, and an officer wearing a bright blue finial entered to await his orders. “I have promised His Excellency Hu a pair of couplets for his daughter's wedding. Whenever you see me with a little time to spare, remind me, so that I don't fail in courtesy. Keep reminding me.” “Yes.” “Good. That settles it.” He asked Hu, “You are going to Shanghai first?” “Yes.” “Is there anything you need me to arrange?” Hu was uneasy about the foreign loan principal soon falling due. But Mi had sent no letter, so he supposed everything had been settled. There was no need to trouble Zuo. “I shall ask when something arises.” “Very well. I have not even found time to give you a dinner on this visit. It is hardly proper.” “You are too courteous. Is there anything you would like me to attend to in Shanghai or Hangzhou?” Zuo thought briefly. “Only those four thousand rifles for Wang Langqing.” “I shall certainly settle that.” “Nothing else. As you said yourself, I shall ask when something comes to mind.” Hu took his leave, then earnestly reminded the attendant officers that they must prompt Zuo about the couplets. Naturally, he also presented a red envelope marked “Parting Gift.”

zh: 一到上海，胡雪岩才失悔在江宁荒废的日子太多了。上海也仿佛变了一个样子，其所谓市面萧条，熟人一见了面，不是打听战事，就是相询何处避难最好？这些情形在江宁是见不到的。做钱庄最怕遇到这样局势，谣言满天，人心惶惶。而且遇到这种时候，有钱的人都相信手握现款是最妥当的事，因此，钱庄由于存款只提不存，周转不灵而倒闭的，已经有好几家。阜康是块金字招牌，所受的影响比较小，但暗中另有危机，只是宓本常守口如瓶，不让胡雪岩知道而已。但即令如此，已使得胡雪岩大为头痛。首先是供应王德榜的四千支洋枪，转运局的库存仅得两千五，尚少一千五百支，需要现购，每支纹银十八两，连水脚约合三万两银子，这倒还是小事，伤脑筋的是，他在左宗棠面前，已经大包大揽地答应下来，如果交不足数，信用有关。“小爷叔亦不必过分重视这件事，将来拿定单给左湘阴看就是了。”“应春，”胡雪岩说：“我在左湘阴面前，说话从来没有打过折扣，而且，这回也只怕是最后一两回替他办差了，为人最要紧收缘结果，一直说话算话，到临了失一回信用，且不说左湘阴保不定会起疑心，以为我没有什么事要仰仗他，对他就不象从前那样子忠心，就是自己，也实在不大甘心，多年做出来的牌子，为这件小事砸掉。应春你倒替我想想，无论如何要帮我一个忙。”办军火一向是古应春的事，从来也没有说过一句客气话，忽然冒出来这么一句“无论如何要帮忙”的话，古应春心里当然也很不是味道。他盘算了好一会说：“看看日本那方面有没有办法好想。如果有现成的货色，日子上还来得及，不过枪价就不能谈了。”“枪价是小事，只要快。应春，你今天就去办。”
en: As soon as he reached Shanghai, Hu regretted the time wasted in Jiangning. The city seemed transformed. Business was depressed. Acquaintances, on meeting, asked either for war news or where it would be safest to take refuge. Nothing of the sort had been apparent in Jiangning. Such conditions were a banker's greatest fear: rumours everywhere and people in panic. The wealthy believed cash in hand was safest, so deposits were withdrawn but not replaced. Several banks had already failed through lack of funds to meet payments. Fukang's excellent name protected it to some extent, but another danger was developing in secret. Mi kept his lips sealed and let Hu know nothing. Even what Hu could see was enough to cause a severe headache. First came Wang Debang's four thousand rifles. The Transport Bureau had only twenty-five hundred in stock, leaving fifteen hundred to buy. At eighteen taels of standard silver each, with freight, they would cost about thirty thousand taels. That was relatively minor. The trouble was that Hu had given Zuo an unqualified promise. Failure to deliver the full number would affect his credit. “You needn't attach too much importance to it, Little Uncle,” Gu said. “You can show Zuo of Xiangyin the order later.” “Yingchun, I have never fallen short of my word to him. This may be one of the last one or two commissions I carry out for him. What matters most is how one finishes. If I break my word at the end, he may suspect that, no longer needing his protection, I am less loyal. Besides, I cannot bear to destroy a name built over so many years for such a small matter. Think of something. You must help me.” Gu had always handled arms purchases, and no such appeal had ever been necessary. The sudden plea made him uncomfortable. After considering for some time, he said, “Let us see whether Japan offers a way. If there is stock ready, we can still make the deadline. But we shall not be able to bargain over the price.” “Price is a small matter. Speed is everything. Start today.”

zh: 古应春依他的要求，奔走了两天，总算有了头绪，急于想要报告胡雪岩，哪知寻来寻去，到处扑空，但到得深夜，古应春正要归寝时，胡雪岩却又不速而至，气色显得有点不大正常。“老爷只怕累坏了。”瑞香亲自来照料，一面端来一杯参汤，一面问道：“饿不饿？”“饿是饿，吃不下。”“你去想想看，”古应春交代，“弄点开胃的东西来消夜。”等瑞香一走，胡雪岩问：“七姐呢？睡了？”“是的。她睡得早。”“那就不惊动她了。”胡雪岩又问：“听说你寻了我一天。”“是啊！古应春很起劲地说：”我有好消息要告诉小爷叔，枪有着落了。““这好！”胡雪岩也很高兴，“是哪里弄来的？”“日本。说起来很有意思，这批枪原来是要卖给法国人的。”“那就更妙了，怎么个来龙去脉？”原来法国仓卒出兵增援，要就地在东方补充一批枪支，找到日本一个军火商，有两千支枪可以出售。古应春多方探查，得到这么一个消息，托人打电报去问，愿出高价买一千五百支。回电讨价二十五两银子一支，另加水脚。“那么，敲定了没有呢？”“敲定了，照他的价钱，水脚归我们自理，已经电汇了一万银子去了。”古应春又说：“半个月去上海交货。”
en: After two days' work, Gu at last had a lead. Eager to tell Hu, he looked everywhere but could not find him. Late that night, just as Gu was about to retire, Hu arrived unannounced, looking unwell. Ruixiang attended to him herself, bringing ginseng broth. “You must be exhausted, Master. Are you hungry?” “Hungry, yes, but I can't eat.” “Think of something appetizing for supper,” Gu told her. When she had gone, Hu asked, “Has Seventh Sister gone to bed?” “Yes. She retires early.” “Then don't disturb her. I hear you have been looking for me all day.” Gu brightened. “I have good news. We have found the rifles.” “Excellent! Where?” “Japan. Interestingly, they were originally intended for the French.” “Better still. How did it happen?” The French had hurriedly sent reinforcements and wanted to obtain additional rifles locally in the East. They had found a Japanese arms dealer with two thousand for sale. Through extensive inquiries, Gu learned of the stock and had a telegram sent offering a high price for fifteen hundred. The reply asked twenty-five taels each, plus freight. “Has the bargain been settled?” “Yes, at his price, with freight for our account. Ten thousand taels have already been telegraphed to him. Delivery in Shanghai in half a month.”

zh: “二十五两就二十五两，总算了掉一桩心事。”胡雪岩忽然问道：“应春，你有没有听说，老宓瞒住我私底下在做南北货？”古应春稍一沉吟后说：“听是听说了，不晓得详细情形。”“据说有一条船碰到法国人的水雷沉掉了，损失不轻。”“损失不会大。”古应春答说：“总买了保险的。”胡雪岩点点头，脸上是安慰的神情，“应春，”他问，“你看我要不要当面跟老宓说破？”这一点关系很大，古应春不敢造次，过了好一会却反问一句：“小爷叔看呢？”“只要风险不大，我觉得不说破比说破了好。俗话说的‘横竖横、拆牛棚’。一说破了，他索性放手大做，那一来，我就非换他不可！苦的是，找不到合适替手。”
en: “Twenty-five it is. At least that is one worry settled.” Hu suddenly asked, “Have you heard that Old Mi is secretly trading in goods from north and south without telling me?” Gu hesitated. “I have heard something, but know no details.” “They say a ship struck a French mine and sank, with a considerable loss.” “The loss can't be large. There would certainly be insurance.” Hu nodded, reassured. “Do you think I should confront him?” The matter was important, and Gu dared not answer hastily. After a long pause, he asked instead, “What do you think?” “As long as the risk isn't great, I think it better to say nothing. As the saying goes, ‘Once you have gone astray, you may as well tear down the cowshed.’ If I expose it, he may simply throw off all restraint and do business on a large scale. Then I shall have to replace him. The difficulty is finding anyone suitable.”

zh: 接下来，胡雪岩谈他的另一个烦恼，应还洋商借款的第二期本金，期限即在十月底，宓本常是十月初就不断到上海道衙门去催问，所得的答复是：备省尚未汇到。及至胡雪岩一到上海，去拜访上海道邵友濂，答复如旧，不过邵友濂多了一句话：“老兄请放心，我尽力去催，期限前后，总可以催齐。”“只能期前，不能期后。邵兄，你晓得的，洋人最讲信用。”“我晓得，不过钱不在我手里，无可奈何。”邵友濂又说：“雪翁，五十万银子，在你算不了一回事，万一期前催不齐，你先垫一垫，不过吃亏几天利息。”一句话将胡雪岩堵得开不出口，“他的话没有说错，我垫一垫当然无所谓，哪晓得偏偏就垫不出。”胡雪岩说：“不巧是巧，有苦难言。”
en: Hu then spoke of another worry. The second repayment of principal on the foreign loan fell due at the end of the tenth lunar month. Since the beginning of that month, Mi had repeatedly asked at the Shanghai circuit intendant's office, only to be told that the provinces had not yet remitted the money. When Hu arrived and called on Shao Youlian, he received the same answer, with one addition: “Don't worry. I shall press them as hard as I can. The money should all be in around the due date.” “It must be before the deadline, not after. You know how particular foreigners are about keeping faith.” “I know. But the money is not in my hands. What can I do? Mr Hu, five hundred thousand taels is nothing to you. If it hasn't all arrived before the deadline, advance it yourself. You will only lose a few days' interest.” That silenced Hu. “He wasn't wrong. Normally an advance would be nothing. Who could have known that this time I couldn't make it? Misfortunes have happened to coincide, and I cannot explain my difficulty.”

zh: 何为“不巧是巧”？古应春要多想一想才明白，不巧的事凑在一起，成为巧合，便是“不巧是巧”。细细想去，不巧的事实在很多，第一是市面不景气，银根极紧。第二是屯丝屯茧这件事，明知早成困局，力求摆脱，但阴借阳差，他的收买新式缫丝厂，为存货找出路的计划，始终未能成功，目前天津、上海都有存丝，但削价求售，亦无买主。第三是左宗棠先为协赈借了二十万银子，如今又要拨付王德榜二十五万两，虽说是转运局的官款，但总是少了一笔可调度的头寸。第四是十一月初五的吉期在即，场面大，开销多，至少还要预备二十万银子。最后就是窗本常私下借客户的名义，提取存款去做南北货生意，照古应春的估计，大概是十万银子左右。“今天十月二十五了。这个月小建，到十一月初五，十天都不到。”胡雪岩说：“这笔头寸摆不平，怎能放心去办喜事。”“小爷叔亦不必着急，到底只有五十万银子。再说，这又不是小爷叔私人的债务，总有办法可想的。”“要想就要早想。”
en: Gu had to think for a moment to understand Hu's phrase: several unlucky circumstances coming together made a coincidence of misfortunes. There were many. First, business was poor and money desperately tight. Second, Hu knew that his stocks of silk and cocoons had trapped him and had tried hard to escape. Yet through one mishap after another, his scheme to acquire modern silk-reeling factories and create an outlet for the stock had never succeeded. Silk remained in both Tianjin and Shanghai, without buyers even at reduced prices. Third, Zuo had already borrowed two hundred thousand taels for relief contributions and now required another two hundred and fifty thousand for Wang Debang. Although these were the Transport Bureau's public funds, their removal still reduced the cash available for Hu to deploy. Fourth, the wedding on the fifth of the eleventh month was approaching. Such a grand occasion meant heavy spending; at least another two hundred thousand taels must be ready. Finally, Mi was privately using customers' names to withdraw deposits for his trade in northern and southern goods. Gu estimated the amount at roughly a hundred thousand taels. “Today is the twenty-fifth of the tenth month,” Hu said. “This month has only twenty-nine days. There are fewer than ten days until the fifth of next month. How can I attend to the wedding with an easy mind until I have put our cash position in order?” “Don't be too anxious. After all, it is only five hundred thousand. And it isn't your personal debt. There must be a solution.” “Then we must look for it early.”

zh: 古应春沉吟了一下说：“如今只有按部就班来，一面催上海道，一面自己来想法子调头寸，如果这两方面都不如意，还有最后一着，请汇丰展期，大不了贴利息。”“这一层我也想到过，就怕人家也同邵筱村一样，来一句‘你先垫一垫好了’。我就没有话好说了。”“不会的。洋人公私分明，公家欠的债，你们不会叫私人来垫的。如果他们真的说这样的话，小爷叔回他一句：”我垫不如你垫，以前汇丰要放款给阜康，阜康不想用，还是用了，如今仍旧算阜康跟汇丰借好了。‘看他怎么说。““这话倒也是。”胡雪岩深深点头。“小爷叔愿意这样做，我就先同汇丰去说好了它。小爷叔不就可以放心了？”“慢慢、慢慢！”胡雪岩连连摇手。原来他有他的顾虑，因为请求展期，无异表示他连五十万银子都无法垫付。这话传出去，砸他的金字招牌，不但左宗棠对他的实力与手腕，会生怀疑，十一月初五那一天，盈门的贺客少不得会谈论这件事，喜事风光，亦将大为减色。
en: After some thought, Gu said, “We can only proceed step by step. Press the Shanghai circuit intendant while making our own arrangements to mobilize funds. If neither succeeds, there is a final course: ask HSBC for an extension. At worst, we pay extra interest.” “I thought of that too. But what if they say, like Shao Xiaocun, ‘Why don't you advance it yourself?’ I shall have no answer.” “They won't. Foreigners distinguish public from private affairs. They won't expect a private person to advance money for a public debt. If they do say so, tell them, ‘Better for you to advance it than for me to do it. Before, HSBC wanted to lend to Fukang. Fukang didn't want the money but eventually took it. Let this again count as a loan from HSBC to Fukang.’ See what they say.” Hu nodded earnestly. “That is true.” “If you agree, I can settle it with HSBC in advance. Then you can put your mind at rest.” “Not so fast!” Hu repeatedly waved his hand. He had his own concerns. Requesting an extension would amount to admitting that he could not even advance five hundred thousand taels. If that became known, it would damage his golden reputation. Zuo would doubt his resources and ability, and on the fifth of the next month the crowds of wedding guests would be bound to discuss it. The glory of the celebration would be greatly diminished.

zh: “我们先走第一步同第二步。”胡雪岩说：“第一步我来，第二步托你。”第一步就是到上海道衙门去催问，第二步“自己想法子来调度”。这一步无非督促宓本常去办。古应春因为有过去的芥蒂，不肯作此吃力不讨好，而且可能徒劳无功的事，因而面有难色。“怎么样？”“我想跟小爷叔调一调，头一步归我，第二步小爷叔自己来。”古应春说：“小爷叔催老宓，名正言顺，我来催老宓，他心里不舒服，不会买帐的。”“也好。”胡雪岩说：“事情要快了。”“我明天一早就去，上海道衙门我有熟人。”古应春说：“小爷叔明天中午来吃饭，听消息。”“好。”胡雪岩说：“这几天我们早晚都要碰头。”
en: “Let us take the first and second steps for now,” Hu said. “I shall handle the first and entrust the second to you.” The first meant pressing the circuit intendant's office; the second, finding ways to arrange funds themselves. In practice, that meant urging Mi to act. Because of their earlier friction, Gu was unwilling to undertake an arduous, thankless task that might achieve nothing. His face showed his reluctance. “What is it?” “I should like us to exchange roles. Leave the first step to me, and take the second yourself. You have every right to press Old Mi. If I do it, he will resent it and pay no attention.” “Very well. But we must act quickly.” “I shall go first thing tomorrow. I have acquaintances at the office. Come for lunch and hear the news.” “Good. These next few days we must see each other morning and evening.”
